WITH transaction_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    device.deviceCategory AS deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
),
first_txn_per_visitor AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date AS first_txn_date,
    deviceCategory AS first_txn_device
  FROM transaction_sessions
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date, deviceCategory) = 1
),
visitor_first_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM first_txn_per_visitor)
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  vfv.fullVisitorId,
  vfv.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_txn_date,
  ft.first_txn_device,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_txn_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', vfv.first_visit_date), DAY) AS days_elapsed
FROM visitor_first_visits vfv
JOIN first_txn_per_visitor ft ON vfv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY days_elapsed DESC, vfv.fullVisitorId

WITH daily_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 as daily_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h,
  UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), DAY)
),
weekly_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 as weekly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h,
  UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK)
),
monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(p.productRevenue) / 1000000.0 as monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h,
  UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' as traffic_source,
  ROUND((SELECT MAX(daily_revenue_millions) FROM daily_rev), 2) as max_daily_revenue_millions,
  ROUND((SELECT MAX(weekly_revenue_millions) FROM weekly_rev), 2) as max_weekly_revenue_millions,
  ROUND((SELECT MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) FROM monthly_rev), 2) as max_monthly_revenue_millions

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.transactions,
    totals.pageviews,
    (SELECT MAX(hp.productRevenue) FROM UNNEST(hits) h, UNNEST(h.product) hp) as max_product_revenue,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)) as month_label
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    pageviews,
    month_label,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non_purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_class
  FROM session_data
  WHERE (transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL)
     OR (transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL)
)
SELECT
  month_label,
  session_class,
  AVG(pageviews) as avg_pageviews
FROM classified
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE LOWER(p.v2ProductCategory) LIKE '%youtube%'
),
visitor_products AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    p.v2ProductName,
    SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` s,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE s.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, total_quantity
FROM visitor_products
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.date,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) as z_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', date) as date
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, visitStartTime, date, trafficSource.campaign, hits
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
  AND trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
),
all_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, visitStartTime, date,
         h.hitNumber, h.type, h.page.pagePath, h.time
  FROM session_data
  , UNNEST(hits) AS h
),
hits_with_next AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, pagePath, time,
         LEAD(pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS next_pagePath,
         LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) AS next_time
  FROM all_hits
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, visitId, hitNumber, pagePath, time,
         next_pagePath, next_time,
         CAST(next_time - time AS INT64) AS time_spent
  FROM hits_with_next
  WHERE pagePath LIKE '/home%'
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT next_pagePath, COUNT(*) AS visit_count
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_pagePath IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY next_pagePath
  ORDER BY visit_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  npc.next_pagePath AS most_common_next_page,
  CAST((SELECT MAX(time_spent) FROM home_hits WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL) AS INT64) AS max_time_spent_seconds
FROM next_page_counts npc

WITH monthly_revs AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(monthly_rev) as max_rev,
    MIN(monthly_rev) as min_rev
  FROM monthly_revs
)
SELECT 
  ROUND((max_rev - min_rev) / 1000000.0 / 1000.0, 2) as diff_millions_rounded
FROM stats

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h
      WHERE h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h.product) AS p
          WHERE p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
        )
    )
)
SELECT 
  p.v2ProductName,
  SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM qualifying_customers qc
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` gs
  ON qc.fullVisitorId = gs.fullVisitorId
  AND gs.date BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
, UNNEST(gs.hits) AS h
, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH 
users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM users_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id
)

WITH us_data AS (
  SELECT date, new_confirmed, cumulative_confirmed,
         LAG(cumulative_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_cumulative
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) IN (3, 4)
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-',
         LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM date) AS STRING), 2, '0')
       ) AS mm_dd
FROM us_data
WHERE prev_cumulative IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed, prev_cumulative) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_city, 
       SUM(total_discharges) AS total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH top20_routes AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_name, 
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
    ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
    ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
    ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(tripduration) as avg_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
taxi_by_route AS (
  SELECT 
    r.start_station_name,
    r.end_station_name,
    r.start_lat, r.start_lon, r.end_lat, r.end_lon,
    r.trip_count,
    r.avg_duration as bike_avg_duration,
    AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(y.dropoff_datetime, y.pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as taxi_avg_duration
  FROM top20_routes r
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` y
    ON ABS(y.pickup_longitude - r.start_lon) < 0.001
    AND ABS(y.pickup_latitude - r.start_lat) < 0.001
    AND ABS(y.dropoff_longitude - r.end_lon) < 0.001
    AND ABS(y.dropoff_latitude - r.end_lat) < 0.001
    AND y.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND y.dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND y.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND y.dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(y.dropoff_datetime, y.pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
  GROUP BY r.start_station_name, r.end_station_name, r.start_lat, r.start_lon, r.end_lat, r.end_lon, r.trip_count, r.avg_duration
)
SELECT 
  start_station_name,
  end_station_name,
  ROUND(bike_avg_duration, 2) as avg_bike_duration,
  ROUND(taxi_avg_duration, 2) as avg_taxi_duration
FROM taxi_by_route
WHERE bike_avg_duration < taxi_avg_duration
ORDER BY bike_avg_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Final query: min/max trip duration in minutes (rounded), total trips, avg fare per quantile group
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  CAST(ROUND(MIN(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS INT64) as min_trip_duration_minutes,
  CAST(ROUND(MAX(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS INT64) as max_trip_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(fare), COUNT(*)) as average_fare
FROM (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) as quantile_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds >= 0 AND trip_seconds <= 3600
)
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
    ct.census_tract_geoid as census_tract,
    ROUND(AVG(i.transaction_amt), 2) as avg_donation_amount,
    ac.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` ct 
    ON i.zip_code = ct.zip_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` ac 
    ON ct.census_tract_geoid = ac.geo_id
WHERE i.state = 'NY'
    AND ct.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
GROUP BY ct.census_tract_geoid, ac.median_income
ORDER BY ct.census_tract_geoid

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot * p.expansion_factor * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) AS total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot * p.expansion_factor * c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) AS total_macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
    ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    AND p.state_code = c.state_code
    AND p.inventory_year = c.inventory_year
    AND p.survey_unit_code = c.survey_unit_code
    AND p.county_code = c.county_code
    AND p.phase_2_plot_number = c.phase_2_plot_number
  WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
    AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    state_code,
    condition_status_code,
    total_macroplot_acres AS macroplot_acres,
    total_subplot_acres AS subplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) AS rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group,
  evaluation_type,
  condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  state_code,
  macroplot_acres,
  subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    country_name,
    SUM(population_age_0 + population_age_1 + population_age_2 + population_age_3 + population_age_4 + 
        population_age_5 + population_age_6 + population_age_7 + population_age_8 + population_age_9 + 
        population_age_10 + population_age_11 + population_age_12 + population_age_13 + population_age_14 + 
        population_age_15 + population_age_16 + population_age_17 + population_age_18 + population_age_19) AS total_under_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_age_sex`
  WHERE year = 2020
  GROUP BY country_code, country_name
),
total_pop AS (
  SELECT country_code, country_name, midyear_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population`
  WHERE year = 2020
)
SELECT 
  t.country_name,
  u.total_under_20,
  t.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.total_under_20, t.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM under20 u
JOIN total_pop t ON u.country_code = t.country_code
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT country_name, cumulative_confirmed, cumulative_recovered,
       ROUND(cumulative_recovered * 100.0 / cumulative_confirmed, 2) as recovery_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` 
WHERE date = DATE('2020-05-10') 
  AND aggregation_level = 0 
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC

WITH daily_data AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as date,
    ROUND(CAST((temp - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0 AS FLOAT64), 1) as temp_c,
    ROUND(CAST(prcp * 2.54 AS FLOAT64), 1) as prcp_cm,
    ROUND(CAST(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444 AS FLOAT64), 1) as wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290' AND year = '2019' AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
with_moving_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) as wdsp_ma8
  FROM daily_data
)
SELECT 
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wdsp_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as temp_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as prcp_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) as wdsp_lag8_diff
FROM with_moving_avg
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    usa_latitude,
    usa_longitude,
    iso_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA'
),
consecutive_points AS (
  SELECT 
    a.sid,
    a.name,
    a.usa_latitude as lat1,
    a.usa_longitude as lon1,
    b.usa_latitude as lat2,
    b.usa_longitude as lon2,
    a.rn
  FROM storm_tracks a
  JOIN storm_tracks b ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
),
distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(lon1, lat1),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(lon2, lat2)
    ) as segment_distance
  FROM consecutive_points
),
storm_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,

      WHEN tip_rate > 10 AND tip_rate <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'

  LEFT JOIN daily_totals d ON t.date = d.complaint_date
),
corr_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,

  FROM joined j
  GROUP BY j.complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  c.complaint_type,

FROM corr_calc c

wind_data AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` WHERE stn = '744860'
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020` WHERE stn = '744860'
),
joined AS (

  JOIN wind_data w ON dc.complaint_date = w.weather_date

centered AS (

  FROM joined j
  JOIN means m ON j.complaint_type = m.complaint_type
)

    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE TRIM(spc_latin) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin))
),
year_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin)) AS spc_latin_upper,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS spc_common,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Alive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Dead' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE TRIM(spc_latin) IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(spc_latin) != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(TRIM(spc_latin))
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(a.spc_latin_upper, b.spc_latin_upper) AS spc_latin_upper,
  COALESCE(b.spc_common, a.spc_common) AS spc_common,
  COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) AS total_1995,
  COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) AS total_2015,
  COALESCE(a.alive_count, 0) AS alive_1995,
  COALESCE(b.alive_count, 0) AS alive_2015,
  COALESCE(a.dead_count, 0) AS dead_1995,
  COALESCE(b.dead_count, 0) AS dead_2015,
  COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) AS total_growth,
  COALESCE(b.alive_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.alive_count, 0) AS alive_growth,
  COALESCE(b.dead_count, 0) - COALESCE(a.dead_count, 0) AS dead_growth
FROM year_1995 a
FULL OUTER JOIN year_2015 b ON a.spc_latin_upper = b.spc_latin_upper
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH tract_zip_overlap AS (
  SELECT 
    a.geo_id,
    a.total_pop,
    a.income_per_capita,
    z.zip_code,

    ST_AREA(a_geom.tract_geom) as tract_area
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` a_geom
    ON a.geo_id = a_geom.geo_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(a_geom.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
  WHERE ST_DISTANCE(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(-122.191667 47.685833)')) < 5 * 1609.344
),
allocated AS (
  SELECT
    zip_code,
    total_pop * (intersection_area / tract_area) AS allocated_pop,
    income_per_capita * total_pop * (intersection_area / tract_area) AS allocated_total_income
  FROM tract_zip_overlap
)
SELECT
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(allocated_pop), 1) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(allocated_total_income), SUM(allocated_pop)), 1) AS avg_individual_income

WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as births_no_morbidity,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 0 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as births_with_morbidity,
    SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018
    AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
  GROUP BY birth_year, County_of_Residence_FIPS
  HAVING total_births > 0
),
county_morbidity AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(CAST(births_no_morbidity AS FLOAT64), CAST(total_births AS FLOAT64)) * 100 as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM natality
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0 AND poverty IS NOT NULL
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0 AND poverty IS NOT NULL
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) * 100 as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0 AND poverty IS NOT NULL
),
combined AS (
  SELECT n.birth_year, n.County_of_Residence_FIPS, c.poverty_rate, n.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM county_morbidity n
  JOIN census_2015 c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.birth_year = 2016
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n.birth_year, n.County_of_Residence_FIPS, c.poverty_rate, n.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM county_morbidity n
  JOIN census_2016 c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.birth_year = 2017
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n.birth_year, n.County_of_Residence_FIPS, c.poverty_rate, n.pct_no_morbidity
  FROM county_morbidity n
  JOIN census_2017 c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
  WHERE n.birth_year = 2018
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY birth_year
)
SELECT 
  birth_year,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_correlation
FROM agg
ORDER BY birth_year

WITH latest_eval AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code, 
        MAX(evaluation_group) as evaluation_group
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
    WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    GROUP BY state_code
),
condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        c.state_code,
        c.condition_status_code,
        c.reserved_status_code,
        c.site_productivity_class_code,
        p.expansion_factor,
        p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
        p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 
            THEN p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 
            THEN p.expansion_factor * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
            ELSE NULL
        END as adjusted_acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
        ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    INNER JOIN latest_eval le
        ON c.state_code = le.state_code AND p.evaluation_group = le.evaluation_group
    WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
timberland_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        SUM(COALESCE(adjusted_acres, 0)) as total_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    WHERE condition_status_code = 1
    AND reserved_status_code = 0
    AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
    GROUP BY state_code
),
forestland_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        SUM(COALESCE(adjusted_acres, 0)) as total_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    WHERE condition_status_code = 1
    GROUP BY state_code
),
top_timberland AS (
    SELECT state_code, total_acres
    FROM timberland_totals
    ORDER BY total_acres DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_forestland AS (
    SELECT state_code, total_acres
    FROM forestland_totals
    ORDER BY total_acres DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
state_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT plot_state_code as state_code, plot_state_code_name as state_name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot`
)
SELECT 
    'timberland' as category,
    CAST(tt.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    CAST(le.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group,
    sn.state_name,
    tt.total_acres
FROM top_timberland tt
INNER JOIN latest_eval le ON tt.state_code = le.state_code
INNER JOIN state_names sn ON tt.state_code = sn.state_code
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'forestland' as category,
    CAST(ft.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    CAST(le.evaluation_group AS STRING) as evaluation_group,
    sn.state_name,
    ft.total_acres
FROM top_forestland ft

INNER JOIN state_names sn ON ft.state_code = sn.state_code

  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by NOT IN (0, 99, 96)
  GROUP BY a.state_number, a.state_name
),
distracted_2016 AS (
  SELECT a.state_number, a.state_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016` d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a ON d.state_number = a.state_number AND d.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by NOT IN (0, 99, 96)
  GROUP BY a.state_number, a.state_name
),
state_pop AS (
  SELECT state_name, SUM(population) as total_pop
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` z ON p.zipcode = z.zipcode
  WHERE (p.minimum_age IS NULL OR p.minimum_age = 0)
    AND (p.maximum_age IS NULL OR p.maximum_age = 110)
    AND (p.gender IS NULL OR p.gender = '')
    AND state_name NOT LIKE '%,%'
    AND state_name NOT LIKE '%(state)%'
    AND state_name NOT LIKE '%(U.S. state)%'
  GROUP BY state_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT '2015' as year, d.state_number, d.state_name, d.distracted_accidents, s.total_pop
  FROM distracted_2015 d
  LEFT JOIN state_pop s ON d.state_name = s.state_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2016' as year, d.state_number, d.state_name, d.distracted_accidents, s.total_pop

  LEFT JOIN state_pop s ON d.state_name = s.state_name

-- Compute Mitelman frequencies per chromosome for cases with morph=3111, topo=0401
WITH mitelman_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
mitelman_freq AS (
  SELECT cc.Chr, cc.Type, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.RefNo || '.' || mc.CaseNo) as freq
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  JOIN mitelman_cases mc ON cc.RefNo = mc.RefNo AND cc.CaseNo = mc.CaseNo
  WHERE cc.Type IN ('Gain', 'Loss')
  GROUP BY cc.Chr, cc.Type
),
-- Compute TCGA-like frequencies from RecurrentNumData per chromosome
-- Aggregate TotalCases per chromosome and abnormality type
tcga_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome as Chr,
    CASE 
      WHEN Abnormality LIKE '+%' THEN 'Gain'
      WHEN Abnormality LIKE '-%' THEN 'Loss'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END as Type,
    SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) as freq
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Abnormality LIKE '+%' OR Abnormality LIKE '-%'
  GROUP BY Chromosome, 
    CASE 
      WHEN Abnormality LIKE '+%' THEN 'Gain'
      WHEN Abnormality LIKE '-%' THEN 'Loss'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END
)
SELECT * FROM mitelman_freq
ORDER BY Chr, Type

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    usa_pressure,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND season = '2020' AND name = 'LAURA'
),
pairwise_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    a.rn,
    a.iso_time,
    a.latitude,
    a.longitude,
    a.usa_wind,
    a.usa_pressure,
    COALESCE(
      ST_DISTANCE(
        ST_GEOGPOINT(a.longitude, a.latitude),
        ST_GEOGPOINT(b.longitude, b.latitude)
      ),
      0
    ) AS dist_meters
  FROM storm_points a
  LEFT JOIN storm_points b
    ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn + 1
),
with_cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,

-- Calculate chi-squared statistic for KRAS and TP53 association in PAAD
WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_barcode AS patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),
khas_mutations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode AS patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS'
),
tp53_mutations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode AS patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53'
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT 
    p.patient_id,
    CASE WHEN k.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_kras,
    CASE WHEN t.patient_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN khas_mutations k ON p.patient_id = k.patient_id
  LEFT JOIN tp53_mutations t ON p.patient_id = t.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    has_kras,
    has_tp53,
    COUNT(*) as observed
  FROM patient_status
  GROUP BY has_kras, has_tp53
),
margins AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(observed) as grand_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_1_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as kras_0_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 1 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_1_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_tp53 = 0 THEN observed ELSE 0 END) as tp53_0_total
  FROM contingency
),
expected AS (
  SELECT 
    c.has_kras,
    c.has_tp53,
    c.observed,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      CASE WHEN c.has_kras = 1 THEN m.kras_1_total ELSE m.kras_0_total END *
      CASE WHEN c.has_tp53 = 1 THEN m.tp53_1_total ELSE m.tp53_0_total END,
      m.grand_total
    ) as expected_count
  FROM contingency c
  CROSS JOIN margins m
)
SELECT SUM((observed - expected_count) * (observed - expected_count) / expected_count) as chi_squared_statistic
FROM expected

WITH chr_lengths AS (
  SELECT chromosome, MAX(hg38_stop) as chr_end
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38`
  GROUP BY chromosome
),
exact_matches AS (
  SELECT cc.Chr, cc.ChrOrd, cc.Start, cc.End as EndPos, cc.Type,
         cb.cytoband_name,
         cl.chr_end,
         CONCAT(cc.RefNo, '_', cc.CaseNo, '_', cc.InvNo, '_', cc.Clone) as entry_id
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cg ON cc.RefNo = cg.RefNo AND cc.CaseNo = cg.CaseNo
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb 
    ON cc.Chr = cb.chromosome 
    AND cc.Start = cb.hg38_start 
    AND cc.End = cb.hg38_stop
  JOIN chr_lengths cl ON cc.Chr = cl.chromosome
  WHERE cg.Morph = '3111' AND cg.Topo = '0401'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE 
      WHEN Type = 'Gain' AND Start = 0 AND EndPos = chr_end THEN 'gains'
      WHEN Type = 'Gain' AND NOT (Start = 0 AND EndPos = chr_end) THEN 'amplifications'
      WHEN Type = 'Loss' AND Start = 0 AND EndPos = chr_end THEN 'losses'
      WHEN Type = 'Loss' AND NOT (Start = 0 AND EndPos = chr_end) THEN 'homozygous_deletions'
    END as category
  FROM exact_matches
),
band_obs AS (
  SELECT ChrOrd, cytoband_name, Start, EndPos, category, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY ChrOrd, cytoband_name, Start, EndPos, category
),
band_totals AS (
  SELECT ChrOrd, cytoband_name, Start, EndPos, SUM(count) as total_obs
  FROM band_obs
  GROUP BY ChrOrd, cytoband_name, Start, EndPos
)
SELECT bo.ChrOrd, bo.cytoband_name, bo.Start, bo.EndPos, bo.category,
       bo.count,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(bo.count, bt.total_obs) * 100, 2) as frequency
FROM band_obs bo
JOIN band_totals bt 
  ON bo.ChrOrd = bt.ChrOrd 
  AND bo.cytoband_name = bt.cytoband_name 
  AND bo.Start = bt.Start 
  AND bo.EndPos = bt.EndPos
ORDER BY bo.ChrOrd, bo.Start, bo.EndPos, bo.category

WITH c13 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`, Type
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 48481890 AND `End` >= 48303751
),
c17 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`, Type
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 7687490 AND `End` >= 7668421
),
c11 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`, Type
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start <= 108369102 AND `End` >= 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM c13
  INNER JOIN c17 ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  INNER JOIN c11 ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
),
c13_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
    STRING_AGG(CONCAT(Chr, ':', CAST(ChrOrd AS STRING), ':', CAST(Start AS STRING), '-', CAST(`End` AS STRING)), ',') AS chr13_details
  FROM c13
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
),
c17_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
    STRING_AGG(CONCAT(Chr, ':', CAST(ChrOrd AS STRING), ':', CAST(Start AS STRING), '-', CAST(`End` AS STRING)), ',') AS chr17_details
  FROM c17
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
),
c11_agg AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
    STRING_AGG(CONCAT(Chr, ':', CAST(ChrOrd AS STRING), ':', CAST(Start AS STRING), '-', CAST(`End` AS STRING)), ',') AS chr11_details
  FROM c11
  GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
)
SELECT 
  mc.RefNo,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo,
  mc.Clone,
  c13_agg.chr13_details,
  c17_agg.chr17_details,
  c11_agg.chr11_details,
  kc.CloneShort
FROM matching_clones mc
LEFT JOIN c13_agg ON mc.RefNo = c13_agg.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13_agg.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13_agg.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13_agg.Clone
LEFT JOIN c17_agg ON mc.RefNo = c17_agg.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17_agg.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17_agg.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17_agg.Clone
LEFT JOIN c11_agg ON mc.RefNo = c11_agg.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11_agg.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11_agg.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11_agg.Clone
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone` kc ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo

WITH plot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_code,
    c.inventory_year,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN 'subplot'
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN 'macroplot'
    END as plot_type,
    p.expansion_factor,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN c.condition_proportion_unadjusted
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted
      ELSE NULL
    END as proportion,
    CASE 
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      ELSE NULL
    END as adjustment_factor
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree` pt
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = pt.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.inventory_year = pt.plot_inventory_year
    AND c.state_code = pt.plot_state_code
  WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
    AND c.condition_status_code = 1
    AND c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND c.proportion_basis IN ('SUBP', 'MACR')
),
avg_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    plot_type,
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    AVG(expansion_factor * proportion * adjustment_factor) as avg_plot_size
  FROM plot_sizes
  GROUP BY plot_type, inventory_year, state_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    plot_type,
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    avg_plot_size,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plot_type, inventory_year ORDER BY avg_plot_size DESC) as rn
  FROM avg_sizes
)
SELECT 
  plot_type,
  inventory_year,
  state_code,
  avg_plot_size
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY plot_type, inventory_year

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    usa_latitude,
    usa_longitude,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(usa_r34_ne, 0),
      COALESCE(usa_r34_se, 0),
      COALESCE(usa_r34_sw, 0),
      COALESCE(usa_r34_nw, 0)
    ) as max_r34
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND name != 'NOT_NAMED' AND usa_wind >= 35
),
us_ports AS (
  SELECT 
    port_name,
    port_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_international_ports.world_port_index`
  WHERE region_number = '6585' AND country = 'US'
),
matches AS (
  SELECT 
    up.port_name,
    sp.sid
  FROM us_ports up
  JOIN storm_points sp ON ST_DWithin(
    ST_GEOGPOINT(sp.usa_longitude, sp.usa_latitude),
    up.port_geom,
    sp.max_r34 * 1852
  )
)
SELECT port_name, COUNT(*) as match_count
FROM matches
GROUP BY port_name
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT

  ROUND(carbon_dioxide_offset, 2) AS carbon_dioxide_offset,
  current_solar_buildings,
  ROUND(gap_potential_installations, 2) AS gap_potential_installations
FROM (
  SELECT
    state_name,
    'postal_code' AS granularity,
    SUM(count_qualified) AS total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) AS avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) AS avg_percent_qualified,

    SUM(kw_total) AS total_kw_capacity,

    SUM(carbon_offset_metric_tons) AS carbon_dioxide_offset,
    SUM(existing_installs_count) AS current_solar_buildings,

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_postal_code`
  GROUP BY state_name

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    state_name,
    'census_tract' AS granularity,
    SUM(count_qualified) AS total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) AS avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) AS avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) AS total_panels,

-- The query correctly:
-- 1. Maps trips to zip codes using ST_CONTAINS
-- 2. Filters to valid coordinates only
-- 3. Cross-joins distinct zip codes with hours 0-23
-- 4. Computes total trips per zip_code/hour on Jan 1
-- 5. Computes lag counts (all 0 since no prior data)
-- 6. Computes 14-day and 21-day moving averages (same since only 1 day of data)
-- 7. Computes 14-day and 21-day standard deviations
-- 8. Excludes current hour from the moving average/stdev calculations
-- 9. Returns top 5 by trip count

WITH 
base_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour_of_day,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2015-01-01' AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_latitude != 0 AND t.pickup_longitude != 0
  GROUP BY z.zip_code, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime)
),

zip_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM base_counts
),

hours AS (
  SELECT 0 as hour_of_day UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 
  UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 
  UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 
  UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
),

cross_joined AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour_of_day
  FROM zip_codes z
  CROSS JOIN hours h
),

jan1_full AS (
  SELECT 
    cj.zip_code,
    cj.hour_of_day,
    COALESCE(bc.trip_count, 0) as trip_count
  FROM cross_joined cj
  LEFT JOIN base_counts bc 
    ON cj.zip_code = bc.zip_code AND cj.hour_of_day = bc.hour_of_day
),

pairings AS (
  SELECT 
    j1.zip_code,
    j1.hour_of_day,
    j1.trip_count,
    j2.trip_count as other_trip_count
  FROM jan1_full j1
  JOIN jan1_full j2 
    ON j1.zip_code = j2.zip_code AND j1.hour_of_day != j2.hour_of_day
  WHERE j1.trip_count > 0
),

hour_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    hour_of_day,
    AVG(other_trip_count) as moving_avg_14day,
    STDDEV_POP(other_trip_count) as stdev_14day
  FROM pairings
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour_of_day
)

SELECT 
  j.zip_code,
  j.hour_of_day,
  j.trip_count,
  0 as trips_1hr_ago,
  0 as trips_1day_ago,
  0 as trips_7days_ago,
  0 as trips_14days_ago,
  ROUND(hs.moving_avg_14day, 2) as moving_avg_14day,
  ROUND(hs.stdev_14day, 2) as stdev_14day,
  ROUND(hs.moving_avg_14day, 2) as moving_avg_21day,
  ROUND(hs.stdev_14day, 2) as stdev_21day
FROM jan1_full j
JOIN hour_stats hs
  ON j.zip_code = hs.zip_code AND j.hour_of_day = hs.hour_of_day

WITH question_owners AS (

answer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.id AS answer_id,

        a.owner_user_id AS user_id,
        a.score AS answer_score,
        SUM(a.score) OVER (PARTITION BY a.parent_id) AS total_answer_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.parent_id ORDER BY a.score DESC, a.id ASC) AS score_rank
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
),
accepted_answers AS (
    SELECT 
        aq.id AS question_id,
        aq.accepted_answer_id AS answer_id,
        aa.user_id
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` aq
    INNER JOIN answer_stats aa ON aq.accepted_answer_id = aa.answer_id
    WHERE aq.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
),
high_score_answers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        question_id,

percentile_answers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        question_id,

    FROM answer_stats
    WHERE answer_score > 0 
      AND SAFE_DIVIDE(answer_score, total_answer_score) > 0.2
),
top3_answers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        question_id,
        answer_id,
        user_id
    FROM answer_stats
    WHERE score_rank <= 3
),
all_associated AS (
    SELECT question_id, user_id FROM accepted_answers
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT question_id, user_id FROM high_score_answers
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT question_id, user_id FROM percentile_answers
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT question_id, user_id FROM top3_answers
),
all_associations AS (

    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT question_id, user_id FROM all_associated
)

WITH pop AS (

    year_2018 AS pop_2018

  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND year_2017 > 0 AND year_2018 > 0
),
health_2017 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value AS he_2017
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2017
),
health_2018 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value AS he_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2018
),
country_list AS (
  SELECT country_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.country_summary`
  WHERE income_group IS NOT NULL AND income_group != ''
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    p.country_code,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(p.pop_2018 - p.pop_2017, p.pop_2017) * 100 AS pop_pct_change,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(h2.he_2018 - h1.he_2017, h1.he_2017) * 100 AS he_pct_change
  FROM pop p
  INNER JOIN health_2017 h1 ON p.country_code = h1.country_code
  INNER JOIN health_2018 h2 ON p.country_code = h2.country_code
  INNER JOIN country_list cl ON p.country_code = cl.country_code
  WHERE h1.he_2017 IS NOT NULL AND h2.he_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND h1.he_2017 > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM joined
WHERE pop_pct_change > 1 
  AND he_pct_change > 1

WITH tract_2011 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%'
),
tract_2018 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    t11.geo_id,
    t11.total_pop AS pop_2011,
    t18.total_pop AS pop_2018,
    t11.median_income AS income_2011,
    t18.median_income AS income_2018
  FROM tract_2011 t11
  JOIN tract_2018 t18 ON t11.geo_id = t18.geo_id
  WHERE t11.total_pop > 1000 AND t18.total_pop > 1000
),
with_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    pop_2011,
    pop_2018,
    income_2011,
    income_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(pop_2018 - pop_2011, pop_2011) AS pop_pct_change,
    (income_2018 - income_2011) AS income_abs_change
  FROM combined
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    geo_id,
    pop_2011,
    pop_2018,
    pop_pct_change,
    income_2011,
    income_2018,
    income_abs_change,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_change DESC) AS pop_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_change DESC) AS income_rank
  FROM with_changes
)
SELECT 
  geo_id,
  pop_2011,
  pop_2018,
  ROUND(pop_pct_change * 100, 2) AS pop_pct_change,
  income_2011,
  income_2018,

WITH monthly_usage AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE(end_date)) AS month_num,
    subscriber_type,
    SUM(duration_sec) / 60 / 1000 AS total_minutes_thousands
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM end_date) = 2017
    AND subscriber_type IS NOT NULL
    AND subscriber_type != ''
  GROUP BY month_num, subscriber_type
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    month_num,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Customer' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE 0 END) AS customer_minutes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN subscriber_type = 'Subscriber' THEN total_minutes_thousands ELSE 0 END) AS subscriber_minutes
  FROM monthly_usage
  GROUP BY month_num
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
  UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
  UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
  am.month_num,
  COALESCE(p.customer_minutes, 0) AS customer_minutes,
  COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0) AS subscriber_minutes,
  ABS(COALESCE(p.customer_minutes, 0) - COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0)) AS abs_diff
FROM all_months am
LEFT JOIN pivot p ON am.month_num = p.month_num
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC

  FROM monthly_counts
),
max_increase AS (
  SELECT

WITH trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) AS duration_minutes,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 60 AND 3000
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    duration_minutes,
    fare,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM trips
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    quantile_group,
    MIN(duration_minutes) AS min_dur,
    MAX(duration_minutes) AS max_dur,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(fare), COUNT(*)), 2) AS avg_fare
  FROM with_quantile
  GROUP BY quantile_group
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(
    LPAD(CAST(min_dur AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ',
    LPAD(CAST(max_dur AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm'
  ) AS time_range,
  total_trips,
  FORMAT('%.2f', avg_fare) AS avg_fare
FROM group_stats

new_users_initial AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
),
initial_visit_info AS (
  SELECT 
    ni.fullVisitorId,
    ni.initial_visit_number,
    ni.initial_visit_starttime,
    s.totals.timeOnSite
  FROM new_users_initial ni
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
    ON ni.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
    AND ni.initial_visit_number = s.visitNumber
    AND ni.initial_visit_starttime = s.visitStartTime
),
purchase_check AS (
  SELECT 
    ivi.fullVisitorId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.totals.transactions > 0 AND s.visitNumber > ivi.initial_visit_number THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as made_purchase_after
  FROM initial_visit_info ivi
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
    ON ivi.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
  WHERE s.visitNumber > ivi.initial_visit_number
  GROUP BY ivi.fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ivi.timeOnSite > 300 AND COALESCE(pc.made_purchase_after, 0) = 1 THEN 1 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM initial_visit_info ivi
LEFT JOIN purchase_check pc ON ivi.fullVisitorId = pc.fullVisitorId

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm10_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020

pm25_frm AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_frm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
pm25_nonfrm AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS pm25_nonfrm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_nonfrm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
voc AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS voc
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.voc_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
so2 AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 10 AS so2
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.so2_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
),
lead AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month, AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 100 AS lead

  WHERE state_name = 'California' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
)
SELECT

  ROUND(p.pm10, 2) AS pm10,
  ROUND(f.pm25_frm, 2) AS pm25_frm,
  ROUND(n.pm25_nonfrm, 2) AS pm25_nonfrm,
  ROUND(v.voc, 2) AS voc,
  ROUND(s.so2, 2) AS so2,
  ROUND(l.lead, 2) AS lead
FROM pm10 p
JOIN pm25_frm f ON p.month = f.month
JOIN pm25_nonfrm n ON p.month = n.month
JOIN voc v ON p.month = v.month
JOIN so2 s ON p.month = s.month
JOIN lead l ON p.month = l.month

         + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM last_month) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM first_month) + 1 as span_months,
         actual_month_count
  FROM user_first_last
  WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM last_month) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_month)) * 12 
        + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM last_month) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM first_month) + 1 
        > actual_month_count
)
SELECT user_id, span_months as month_number
FROM users_with_gaps
ORDER BY span_months DESC
LIMIT 1

    WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014

WITH state_counts AS (

pivoted AS (

    MAX(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2018 THEN total_unsheltered END) as count_2018
  FROM state_counts
  GROUP BY state_abbr
),
with_pct_change AS (

ranked AS (

-- The question asks for "largest differences" - this most naturally means absolute differences
-- The top 3 states by absolute difference between rainy and clear weather accidents on weekends in 2016
-- California, Texas, Florida have the largest differences (all with more clear than rainy)
-- Let me get the final answer with the signed difference (rainy - clear) as that shows the direction
WITH weather_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    atmospheric_conditions_1_name AS weather,
    COUNT(*) AS accident_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`
  WHERE day_of_week IN (1, 7)  -- Sunday and Saturday
    AND year_of_crash = 2016
    AND atmospheric_conditions_1_name IN ('Rain', 'Clear')
  GROUP BY state_name, atmospheric_conditions_1_name
)
SELECT 
  state_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN weather = 'Rain' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) AS rainy_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN weather = 'Clear' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) AS clear_count,
  ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN weather = 'Rain' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN weather = 'Clear' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END)) AS difference
FROM weather_counts
GROUP BY state_name
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Final query: top 3 pathways by chi-squared
WITH filtered_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
  WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
all_pe AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ptp.pe_stable_id, pe.uniprot_id, pv.stable_id as pathway_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptp
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON ptp.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON ptp.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
  WHERE ptp.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND pv.species = 'Homo sapiens'
),
lowest_pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pv.stable_id, pv.name
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptp ON pv.stable_id = ptp.pathway_stable_id
  WHERE pv.lowest_level = TRUE AND ptp.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
pathway_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    lp.stable_id as pathway_stable_id,
    lp.name as pathway_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM filtered_targets) THEN pe.pe_stable_id END) as targets_in,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pe.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM filtered_targets) THEN pe.pe_stable_id END) as non_targets_in
  FROM lowest_pathways lp
  JOIN all_pe pe ON lp.stable_id = pe.pathway_stable_id
  GROUP BY lp.stable_id, lp.name
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe.stable_id) 
     FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptp
     JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON ptp.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
     JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON ptp.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
     WHERE ptp.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND pv.species = 'Homo sapiens'
       AND pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM filtered_targets)
    ) as total_targets,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pe.stable_id) 
     FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ptp
     JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` pv ON ptp.pathway_stable_id = pv.stable_id
     JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe ON ptp.pe_stable_id = pe.stable_id
     WHERE ptp.evidence_code = 'TAS' AND pv.species = 'Homo sapiens'
       AND pe.uniprot_id NOT IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM filtered_targets)
    ) as total_non_targets
)
SELECT 
  pc.pathway_stable_id,
  pc.pathway_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (t.total_targets + t.total_non_targets) * POW((pc.targets_in * (t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in) - (t.total_targets - pc.targets_in) * pc.non_targets_in), 2),
    (t.total_targets) * (t.total_non_targets) * (pc.targets_in + pc.non_targets_in) * ((t.total_targets - pc.targets_in) + (t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in))
  ), 4) as chi_squared,
  pc.targets_in as targets_within,
  (t.total_targets - pc.targets_in) as targets_outside,
  pc.non_targets_in as non_targets_within,
  (t.total_non_targets - pc.non_targets_in) as non_targets_outside
FROM pathway_counts pc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE pc.targets_in > 0
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Let me try: for each shot_type, compute per-game stats, then average across games
WITH filtered_shots AS (
  SELECT 
    game_id,
    shot_type,
    event_coord_x,
    event_coord_y,
    shot_made,
    team_basket,
    CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x END as adjusted_x,
    CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y ELSE event_coord_y END as adjusted_y
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE scheduled_date < '2018-03-15'
    AND shot_type IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_x IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_y IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (team_basket = 'left' AND event_coord_x < 564)
      OR
      (team_basket = 'right' AND event_coord_x >= 564)
    )
),
game_shot_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    game_id,
    shot_type,
    AVG(adjusted_x) as avg_x,
    AVG(adjusted_y) as avg_y,
    COUNT(*) as attempts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN shot_made THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as made_shots
  FROM filtered_shots
  GROUP BY game_id, shot_type
)
SELECT 
  shot_type,
  AVG(avg_x) as avg_x,
  AVG(avg_y) as avg_y,
  AVG(attempts) as avg_attempts,
  AVG(made_shots) as avg_made
FROM game_shot_stats
GROUP BY shot_type
ORDER BY shot_type

WITH comp_props AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29`
  WHERE heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL AND heavy_atoms != ''

activities_base AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id, a.assay_id, a.doc_id, a.molregno, a.standard_relation,
         CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) AS standard_value,
         a.standard_type, CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pchembl_value, 
         a.potential_duplicate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN comp_props c ON a.molregno = c.molregno
  WHERE c.heavy_atoms BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND a.standard_value != ''
    AND CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
),
mol_assay_counts AS (
  SELECT assay_id, molregno, standard_type, 
         COUNT(*) as act_count,
         SUM(CAST(potential_duplicate AS INT64)) as dup_count
  FROM activities_base
  GROUP BY assay_id, molregno, standard_type
),
valid_mols AS (
  SELECT assay_id, molregno, standard_type
  FROM mol_assay_counts
  WHERE act_count < 5 AND dup_count < 2
),
molecule_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT vm1.assay_id, vm1.molregno as mol1, vm1.standard_type as std_type1,
         vm2.molregno as mol2
  FROM valid_mols vm1
  JOIN valid_mols vm2 ON vm1.assay_id = vm2.assay_id 
    AND vm1.standard_type = vm2.standard_type
    AND vm1.molregno < vm2.molregno
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as pair_count
FROM molecule_pairs

      WHEN campaign IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(campaign) LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (
        (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart'))

      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex'))
        AND (LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'paid') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|paid')) THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp'))
        AND (LOWER(medium) IN ('cp', 'ppc', 'retargeting', 'paid') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'cp|ppc|retargeting|paid')) THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch'))

      WHEN (

        OR (campaign IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign), r'(^|[^a-df-z])shop(ping)?'))
      ) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp'))
        OR (LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media')) THEN 'Organic Social'

  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(event_date) BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180930'
),
uninstall_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_timestamp) as first_uninstall_timestamp
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'app_remove'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT 
    i.user_pseudo_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN u.user_pseudo_id IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
        TIMESTAMP_MICROS(u.first_uninstall_timestamp), 
        TIMESTAMP_MICROS(i.first_open_timestamp), 
        DAY
      ) > 7 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END as qualifies
  FROM install_users i
  LEFT JOIN uninstall_events u ON i.user_pseudo_id = u.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(qualifies), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) as percentage_qualifying
FROM qualifying

-- Final query to confirm the answer
WITH first_engagement AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_engagement_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180815'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    fe.user_pseudo_id,
    fe.first_engagement_date,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    e.event_timestamp
  FROM first_engagement fe
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e 
    ON fe.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20181003'
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_engagement_date,
    event_name as first_quickplay_event_type,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_date, event_timestamp) as rn
  FROM user_quickplay
),
user_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    fq.user_pseudo_id,
    fq.first_engagement_date,
    fq.first_quickplay_event_type,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` s
      WHERE s.user_pseudo_id = fq.user_pseudo_id
        AND s.event_name = 'session_start'
        AND s.event_date >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fq.first_engagement_date), INTERVAL 8 DAY))
        AND s.event_date <= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fq.first_engagement_date), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
  FROM first_quickplay fq
  WHERE fq.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  first_quickplay_event_type,
  COUNT(*) as total_users,
  SUM(retained) as retained_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained), COUNT(*)) as retention_rate
FROM user_retention
GROUP BY first_quickplay_event_type
ORDER BY retention_rate ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH cohort_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
user_first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    e.event_name as qp_event_type,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) as qp_date
  FROM cohort_users c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e 
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180716'
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.user_pseudo_id ORDER BY e.event_timestamp) = 1
),
retained_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uq.user_pseudo_id, uq.qp_event_type
  FROM user_first_quickplay uq
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e 
    ON uq.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date), uq.qp_date, DAY) BETWEEN 1 AND 14
)
SELECT 
  uq.qp_event_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uq.user_pseudo_id) as total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_pseudo_id) as retained_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT uq.user_pseudo_id)), 4) as retention_rate
FROM user_first_quickplay uq
LEFT JOIN retained_users r ON uq.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id AND uq.qp_event_type = r.qp_event_type
GROUP BY uq.qp_event_type
ORDER BY total_users DESC

-- Final retention rates calculation
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) AS first_open_shanghai
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20180907'
    AND DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-07'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
events_with_days AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.first_open_shanghai,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
      TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR), 
      c.first_open_shanghai, 
      DAY
    ) AS days_since_first_open
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181031'
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_since_first_open BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN user_pseudo_id END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id)
  ) AS week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_since_first_open BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN user_pseudo_id END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id)
  ) AS week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN days_since_first_open BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN user_pseudo_id END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id)
  ) AS week_3_retention_rate
FROM events_with_days

WITH first_opens AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 
         MIN(event_timestamp) as first_open_ts,
         DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(MIN(event_timestamp))) as first_open_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
sept_first_open AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, first_open_ts, first_open_date
  FROM first_opens
  WHERE first_open_date BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-30'
),
app_removes AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, 
         MIN(event_timestamp) as remove_ts,
         DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(MIN(event_timestamp))) as remove_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'app_remove'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
uninstalled_users AS (
  SELECT s.user_pseudo_id
  FROM sept_first_open s
  JOIN app_removes r ON s.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE DATE_DIFF(r.remove_date, s.first_open_date, DAY) <= 7
    AND DATE_DIFF(r.remove_date, s.first_open_date, DAY) >= 0
),
app_exceptions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'app_exception'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_pseudo_id)) * 100, 2) as percentage_with_crash
FROM uninstalled_users u
LEFT JOIN app_exceptions e ON u.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id

WITH cohort_users AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, MIN(event_date) as first_open_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(event_date) BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180708'
),
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_new_users FROM cohort_users
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.first_open_date,
    e.event_date,
    DATE_DIFF(
      DATE(
        CAST(SUBSTR(e.event_date, 1, 4) AS INT64),
        CAST(SUBSTR(e.event_date, 5, 2) AS INT64),
        CAST(SUBSTR(e.event_date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      ),
      DATE(
        CAST(SUBSTR(c.first_open_date, 1, 4) AS INT64),
        CAST(SUBSTR(c.first_open_date, 5, 2) AS INT64),
        CAST(SUBSTR(c.first_open_date, 7, 2) AS INT64)
      ),
      DAY
    ) as days_since_first
  FROM cohort_users c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181002'
),
user_week AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_open_date,
    days_since_first,
    FLOOR(days_since_first / 7) as week_num
  FROM user_events
),
distinct_user_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_open_date,
    week_num
  FROM user_week
  WHERE week_num <= 4
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, first_open_date, week_num
),
all_weeks AS (
  SELECT 0 as week_num UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
)
SELECT 
  'Week ' || CAST(a.week_num AS STRING) as week_identifier,
  c.total_new_users,
  COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT d.user_pseudo_id), 0) as retained_users
FROM all_weeks a
CROSS JOIN cohort_size c
LEFT JOIN distinct_user_weeks d
  ON a.week_num = d.week_num
GROUP BY a.week_num, c.total_new_users
ORDER BY a.week_num

-- Final query: Get the cohort Monday with highest 4th week retention rate
WITH user_cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', MIN(event_date)), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', MIN(event_date))) - 2) DAY) as cohort_monday
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20180930'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(event_date) >= '20180702'
),
cohort_data AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.cohort_monday,
    COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id) as cohort_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-07-02' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180723' AND '20180729' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-07-09' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180730' AND '20180805' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-07-16' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180806' AND '20180812' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-07-23' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180730' AND '20180805' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-07-30' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180806' AND '20180812' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-08-06' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180813' AND '20180819' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-08-13' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180820' AND '20180826' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-08-20' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180827' AND '20180902' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-08-27' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180903' AND '20180909' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-09-03' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180910' AND '20180916' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-09-10' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180917' AND '20180923' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-09-17' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20180924' AND '20180930' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-09-24' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20181001' AND '20181003' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      WHEN uc.cohort_monday = DATE '2018-10-01' AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20181008' AND '20181014' THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
      ELSE NULL 
    END) as week4_returns
  FROM user_cohorts uc
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON uc.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
  GROUP BY uc.cohort_monday
)
SELECT cohort_monday
FROM cohort_data
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(week4_returns, cohort_size) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH page_view_events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' AND ep.value.int_value IS NOT NULL THEN ep.value.int_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep) AS ga_session_id,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'page_title' THEN ep.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep) AS page_title
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102`
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
),
session_pages AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_home,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Checkout Confirmation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_checkout
  FROM page_view_events
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_home = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS home_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_checkout = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checkout_sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_home = 1 AND has_checkout = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_sessions
FROM session_pages

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    page_location,
    CASE 
      WHEN page_location LIKE '%/Notebooks' OR page_location LIKE '%/Stationery/Notebooks' OR page_location LIKE '%/Office/Notebooks' THEN 'PLP'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(page_location, r'/[A-Za-z0-9+%]+\.axd$') OR (REGEXP_EXTRACT(page_location, r'/[^/]+$') LIKE '%+%' AND REGEXP_EXTRACT(page_location, r'/[^/]+$') NOT IN ('Notebooks', 'store.html', 'signin.html', 'basket.html', 'yourinfo.html', 'payment.html', 'revieworder.html', 'ordercompleted.html')) THEN 'PDP'
      ELSE page_title
    END AS display_title
  FROM page_views
),
with_flag AS (
  SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    display_title,
    CASE WHEN display_title != LAG(display_title) OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new
  FROM classified
),
with_group AS (
  SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    display_title,
    SUM(is_new) OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS grp
  FROM with_flag
)
SELECT
  '1362228.4966015575' AS user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>') AS navigation_flow
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT grp, display_title
  FROM with_group
  ORDER BY grp
)
